    Class
    Description
    DhcpLeaseParser
    The dhcp lease list parser parses the response of the Linux command line tool dhcp-lease-list.
    DnsEntriesParser
    The dns entries parser parses the response of the Linux command line tool samba-tool dns query <server> <zone> <name> <A|AAAA|PTR|CNAME|MX|NS|SOA|SRV|TXT|ALL> [options]***, for example samba-tool dns query dc1 samdom.example.org @ ALL.
    DnsZoneListParser
    The dns zone list parser parses Linux command line tool samba-tool dns zonelist <server> [options], for example samba-tool dns zonelist dc1 --primary.
    DnsZoneParser
    The dns zone parser parses Linux command line tool samba-tool dns zoneinfo <server> <zone> [options], for example samba-tool dns zoneinfo dc1 samdom.example.org.
    DomainInfoParser
    The domain info parser parses Linux command line tool samba-tool domain info <ip_address> [options], for example samba-tool domain info dc1.

    The host name parser.
    PasswordInformationParser
    The password information parser parses Linux command line tool samba-tool domain passwordsettings show.
